conteudo.enunciado:
Equity is about giving people what they need, in order to
make things fair. This is not the same as equality, social
justice, nor is it the same as inequality. It is giving more to
those who need it, which is proportionate to their own
circumstances, in order to ensure that everyone has the
same opportunities; for example providing more support to
a disadvantaged student so they can reach their full
potential.
(Adaptado de https://social-change.co.uk/blog/2019-03-29-equality-and-equity; https://cx.report/2020/06/02/equity/. Acessado em 22/07/2020.)
Sabemos que esses conceitos são complexos. Diante
disso, o designer Tony Ruth os representou graficamente,
como ilustram as figuras a seguir. Assinale a alternativa
que mais se aproxima do conceito destacado no trecho
anterior.
